_readme: S485 SkyElderberry, 2026-10-26. Three of Hartnell's degree records fail arithmetic on their general education or degree total (handoff 458 item 3): Nursing-Registered Nursing A.S. 03570 names Local GE with no units (the Local GE set step's pattern did not match its tab), Respiratory Care B.S. 44537 names Cal-GETC and a 120-unit total with no GE units (a baccalaureate), and Vocational Nursing A.S. 39248 sums to 80-89 against 63. This read prints each Requirements tab's own words around its general education and totals. Three tabs, no model call.

outside_hosts.coursedog.com: Hartnell's catalog vendor hosts the catalog itself (hartnell.catalog.prod.coursedog.com) and its data (app.coursedog.com); the registry's catalog address is on this host.

questions.ge: How each tab words its general education (the pattern's name, any units) and its totals (major, degree), and whether prerequisites count toward the degree total.
